purpose: Teach: にわかに/あっし/ふふふ/しだいに/ともなう/おさめ/割り切っ/ちょくちょく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、にわかに雨が強くなってきたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the rain just got heavy all of a sudden.
lines.style: Soft observation, gazing outward. Quiet concern wrapped in gentleness. Slow, measured pace. Voice trails slightly on the last word, inviting acknowledgment without demanding response.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お年寄りのお客様、ご自分を「あっし」と仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard an elderly customer earlier — she called herself 'asshi.' Isn't that charming?
lines.style: Bright, almost delighted recollection. Animated but not loud. A small smile in the voice. Speaks as though sharing something precious that landed with her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ご友人とのお話、ふふふと笑い声が聞こえたわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: There was laughter — real laughter — coming from a table with friends. It made me happy.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried. Soft affection underneath. Each phrase deliberate, as if savoring the memory. Slight warmth on 'happy' — genuine pleasure, not performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の人気、しだいに広がってきたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your shop's reputation is spreading. More people are finding their way here.
lines.style: Pleased acknowledgment, grounded and steady. Not gushing — factual delight. Warm but measured, like someone noticing something good quietly happening.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、店舗拡大にともなう人手不足、対策しないとね、メイちゃん
lines.en: With the shop growing, though — we'll need to think about staffing. We can't let it slip.
lines.style: Thoughtful, grounded. Practical concern beneath the gentleness. Slight weight on the words. Not alarmist, but clear. The tone of someone who sees a problem and cares enough to name it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お釣り、ちゃんと金庫におさめましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Make sure the change goes properly into the register, won't you?
lines.style: Gentle instruction, not commanding. Warm but attentive. The tone of someone who notices details and cares that they're handled right. Brief, clear, with a soft finality.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のご意見も割り切ってお聞きしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Listen to what customers are telling you — even the difficult feedback. Take it as it is.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful guidance. Slower pace. Not harsh, but clear-eyed. Speaking as someone who has learned this matters. A teacher's tone without condescension.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ちょくちょくお見えになって嬉しいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It makes me so happy when customers keep coming back. You're building something real here.
lines.style: Warm, genuine pleasure. Soft and sincere, without being saccharine. A small smile, genuine recognition. Trailing warmth on the final thought, as if she's marveling at something good.
